objective: Validate an ABI extraction mechanism that turns one frozen open-weight teacher's raw responses into complete, prompt-grounded, domain-segregated targets without a second model, silent rewriting, or LayerCake involvement.

scope_correction.teacher_role: Generate candidate and repaired targets only.
scope_correction.layercake_role: Later acquire and execute the same qualified artifact.

repair.method: Return the prior candidate to the same frozen teacher with the original task and literal requirements derived only from its preregistered closed evaluator.

implementation_lock.implementation_tests: 25 passed including extraction, source runtime, and segregation tests

pass_requirements: Every one of the 168 catalog records has a selected target.
Every selected target is a verbatim output from the same pinned Qwen teacher.
Every selected target EOS-terminates and passes its original prompt-bound evaluator.
Every raw seed and repair attempt retains authoritative generated token IDs, input tokens, output bytes, prompt, finish reason, and generation ceiling.
All records retain empty domain labels and claims and remain scoped to english_core.
No second model, LayerCake, or final-test data is used.
decision_rule: Run exactly one two-round repair preflight from the immutable V84 seed outputs.
Reject the mechanism if any record remains unresolved; do not hide or hand-edit failures.
If all 168 records pass, preregister a durable full-catalog extraction using the same mechanism and accounting.
A V86 pass validates target extraction only. It does not authorize a LayerCake quality claim until the full artifact passes the matched transformer information-adequacy gate.
